description: Elections Commission - R. A. D. S. J. Ranawaka of the Seethawaka Pradeshiya sabha has Vacated his office of Members of the United National Party, M. D. M Chandralatha of the Seethawaka Pradeshiya sabha has Vacated his office of Members of the United National Party
reasoning: This gazette contains a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of the Seethawaka Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, fitting the Elections category (Type 7) which includes matters such as candidate registrations, vacating of offices, and electoral commission decisions.
